content.title:
IIM B UGAT is on *15 Nov.*
Use the weeks left well.
content.subtitle: Four things to do between now and the exam. No new chapters needed.

steps.title: Take the 2025 paper, timed
steps.detail: Sit the real IIM B UGAT 2025 paper in one go, with a timer. It shows you exactly where your time goes.
steps.tip: All 60 questions of the 2025 paper are in the PYQ section of the IPM Careers portal.

steps.title: One DI and LR set a day
steps.detail: The paper has a DI & LR section. One set every day keeps you quick at reading tables and clues.

steps.title: Redo your mistakes
steps.detail: This close to the exam, the easiest marks are in questions you already got wrong. Redo them until they feel easy.

steps.title: Read one long article a day
steps.detail: VARC rewards reading speed. Read one editorial a day and write its main idea in a single line.

content.saveLine: Send it to a friend who is writing IIM B UGAT on 15 Nov.
